source.text_it: Nella scelta del veicolo da adibire al trasporto di merci è di fondamentale importanza il tipo di materia che si intende trasportare e il tipo di itinerario che normalmente si effettuerà

records.localized_text: When choosing a goods vehicle, the type of material and usual route are fundamentally important.

source.text_it: E' particolarmente indicato l'utilizzo di autoarticolati per il trasporto di merce, quando le operazioni di carico e scarico sono lunghe ed è conveniente sganciare il semirimorchio per effettuarle

records.localized_text: Articulated vehicles are especially suitable when loading and unloading take a long time and uncoupling the semi-trailer is advantageous.

source.text_it: Al trasportatore di merci pericolose ADR deve essere fornita la scheda di istruzioni scritte da parte dello speditore

records.localized_text: The consignor must provide the ADR dangerous-goods carrier with written instructions.

source.text_it: Si può avere l'esonero della responsabilità del conducente per ritardo o non esecuzione del trasporto se lo stesso prova la sua estraneità al fatto o che non sia a lui imputabile l'evento che ha provocato l'inadempimento

records.localized_text: A driver may be exempted from liability for delay or non-performance if they prove non-involvement or that the event causing non-performance is not attributable to them.

source.text_it: Per ottenere una corretta ripartizione del carico sugli assi, un unico collo molto pesante deve essere posizionato nella parte centrale del piano di carico

records.localized_text: For correct axle load distribution, a single very heavy package must be placed centrally on the load platform.

source.text_it: Per evitare lo spostamento del carico durante la marcia del veicolo è indispensabile agire su sterzo, freni ed acceleratore con gradualità

records.localized_text: To prevent cargo movement while driving, steering, brakes and accelerator must be operated gradually.

source.text_it: Le merci che richiedono un rapido trasporto per essere consumate fresche o attenzioni particolari per la conservazione sono classificate come deperibili

records.localized_text: Goods needing rapid transport for fresh consumption or special preservation care are classified as perishable.

source.text_it: Un carico di sabbia su un autocarro va protetto con un telo, adeguatamente fissato, che ne impedisca la dispersione

records.localized_text: A truckload of sand must be protected by a properly secured sheet to prevent dispersal.

source.text_it: Il carico deve essere compatibile con la portata e il volume utili del veicolo

records.localized_text: Cargo must be compatible with the vehicle's payload and usable volume.

source.text_it: Nel contratto di trasporto di merci, per ritardo s'intende il mancato rispetto, da parte del vettore, del termine contrattualmente stabilito per l'adempimento

records.localized_text: In a goods transport contract, delay means the carrier's failure to meet the contractually agreed performance deadline.

source.text_it: Se il destinatario è irreperibile ovvero si rifiuta o ritarda a chiedere la riconsegna delle cose trasportate, il conducente deve domandare immediatamente istruzioni al responsabile dell’impresa di cui è dipendente

records.localized_text: If a consignee cannot be found or refuses or delays requesting delivery, the driver must immediately ask the employing company's manager for instructions.

source.text_it: Nel contratto di trasporto di merci, per perdita totale s'intende la mancata riconsegna delle merci al destinatario nel luogo di destinazione convenuto, a qualunque causa e motivo detta mancata riconsegna sia dovuta

records.localized_text: In a goods transport contract, total loss means failure to deliver goods to the consignee at the agreed destination, whatever the cause.

source.text_it: Nel contratto di trasporto di merci, per perdita parziale s'intende una diminuzione nel peso, nella misura o nel numero delle cose riconsegnate a destinazione rispetto alle merci consegnate al vettore per il trasporto

records.localized_text: In a goods transport contract, partial loss means a reduction in weight, measure or number delivered compared with what was handed to the carrier.

source.text_it: Il conducente deve mettere le cose trasportate a disposizione del destinatario nel luogo, nel termine e con le modalità indicati dall’impresa da cui dipende

records.localized_text: The driver must make goods available to the consignee at the place, time and in the manner specified by the employing company.

source.text_it: Nel contratto di trasporto di merci, per avaria s'intende un'alterazione delle qualità (interne ed esterne) della merce, tale da comportare una diminuzione di valore

records.localized_text: In a goods transport contract, damage means an alteration of internal or external qualities reducing the goods' value.

source.text_it: Il conducente, per dimostrare di essere alle dipendenze di una impresa di autotrasporto di cose per conto di terzi, durante la guida deve avere con sé la carta tachigrafica

records.localized_text: A driver must carry a tachograph card while driving to prove employment by a third-party haulage company.

source.text_it: Nel caso in cui il conducente di un autocarro circoli con un sovraccarico eccedente il 10% la massa complessiva a pieno carico indicata nella carta di circolazione, è prevista una sanzione amministrativa e sospensione della patente

records.localized_text: A truck driver exceeding the registration-document maximum laden mass by over 10% faces an administrative penalty and licence suspension.

source.text_it: Per trasportare animali vivi è sufficiente acquistare o far attrezzare un apposito autocarro con le specifiche tecniche previste dalla disciplina comunitaria

records.localized_text: To transport live animals, it is enough to buy or equip a suitable truck meeting EU technical specifications.

source.text_it: Se il destinatario è irreperibile o si rifiuta di ricevere le cose trasportate, il conducente deve riportarle immediatamente al mittente

records.localized_text: If a consignee cannot be found or refuses delivery, the driver must immediately return the goods to the consignor.

source.text_it: Se il destinatario è irreperibile o si rifiuta di ricevere le cose trasportate, il conducente deve chiamare gli organi di polizia

records.localized_text: If a consignee cannot be found or refuses delivery, the driver must call police.

source.text_it: Nel trasporto di talune derrate surgelate o congelate con furgone ATP, durante alcune operazioni di breve durata, è ammesso un innalzamento della temperatura sulla superficie del prodotto in una parte del carico di al massimo 1 grado centigrado

records.localized_text: When carrying certain frozen foods in an ATP van, brief operations may raise surface temperature in part of the load by at most 1 degree Celsius.

source.text_it: Sui colli che contengono rifiuti pericolosi deve essere apposta un'etichetta inamovibile a fondo bianco recante le lettere "RP" di colore rosso

records.localized_text: Packages containing hazardous waste must carry a permanent white label bearing red letters "RP".

source.text_it: Per il trasporto di merci pericolose devono essere utilizzati veicoli cisterna conforme alle prescrizioni delle norme ATP

records.localized_text: Dangerous goods must be transported in tanks complying with ATP requirements.

source.text_it: Per il trasporto di merci pericolose devono essere utilizzati veicoli dotati dei pneumatici rinforzati

records.localized_text: Dangerous goods must be transported in vehicles with reinforced tyres.

source.text_it: La sigla ATP si riferisce all’autorizzazione al trasporto di prodotti petroliferi

records.localized_text: ATP refers to authorisation to transport petroleum products.

rows.text: The goods determine the cargo space and payload needed; the route may require a vehicle suited to size and access restrictions.
evidence: DVSA, longer semi-trailers implementation guide, Completing route plans and risk assessments, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/longer-semi-trailer-lst-implementation-guide-for-operators/longer-semi-trailers-full-implementation-guide-for-operators — HGV suitability to load and route; UK operational guidance, not Italian law.

DVSA roadworthiness guide, Bridge strike prevention, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness/guide-to-maintaining-roadworthiness-commercial-goods-and-passenger-carrying-vehicles — vehicle dimensions and route planning to avoid low bridges.

rows.text: The semitrailer can be detached for loading or unloading, leaving the tractor available for other work.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 54, definizione di trattore stradale per semirimorchi e autoarticolato https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-54.php

rows.text: The quiz marks VERO, but the rules have changed: ADR 2003 required the consignor to give instructions to the driver and information about their contents to the carrier; this is not the same wording as the question. Under ADR 2025 the carrier supplies the written instructions to the crew before the journey in languages they understand.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:31994L0055(02) — historical ADR 2003 5.4.3.2: consignor instructions for driver and information on their content to carrier; indexed text only, full page access limited.

https://www.mindop.sk/fileadmin/documents/doprava/nebezpecnetovary/cesta/ADR_2025_Vol._II._EN.pdf — ADR 2025 §5.4.3.2, carrier supplies crew instructions; primary indexed text; https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/adr/adr-instructions-in-writing — directly inspected UK government guidance corroborates carrier-to-crew responsibility.

rows.text: Liability for nonperformance or delay can be excluded if it is proved to result from a cause not attributable to the party concerned; delay alone does not establish this.
evidence: Codice civile art. 1218 e 1256: prova della causa non imputabile e impossibilità temporanea https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ita197336.pdf

rows.text: Place a heavy package near the vehicle’s centre line to support lateral stability. Its position along the bed must still be checked against permitted axle loads: the geometric centre alone does not guarantee correct distribution.
evidence: DVSA load securing basics, Where to put the load, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/securing-loads-on-hgvs-and-goods-vehicles/2-load-securing-the-basics — heavy loads near centre line for lateral stability; axle limits require separate check. Centre line is not proof that longitudinal geometric midpoint gives correct axle distribution.

rows.text: Smooth maneuvers limit forces that can shift goods; the load must still be secured against forces encountered on the road.
evidence: Direttiva 2014/47/UE allegato III, I.1 e I.4: forze in accelerazione e frenata e sistemi di trattenuta https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:02014L0047-20220927

rows.text: Perishable goods can deteriorate quickly: journey time and storage conditions, such as temperature, affect their quality.
evidence: UNECE, accordo ATP, allegati 2 e 3: condizioni di temperatura per derrate deperibili https://unece.org/info/Transport/Perishable-Foodstuffs/pub/2657

rows.text: Sand can scatter during a journey. A properly secured sheet contains it and helps prevent it falling onto the road.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 164 comma 1: il carico deve essere sistemato evitando caduta e dispersione https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-164.php

rows.text: The goods must be within the available payload, and their size must fit the cargo space and dimensional limits.
evidence: Codice della strada artt. 164 commi 1–2 e 167 comma 1: sistemazione, sagoma e massa https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-164.php ; https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-167.php

rows.text: Delay means performance beyond the agreed deadline; it is distinct from loss of or damage to the goods.
evidence: Codice civile artt. 1218 e 1687: ritardo nell’adempimento e messa a disposizione nel termine contrattuale https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ita197336.pdf

rows.text: The driver promptly reports the obstacle to the company for instructions. The carrier must immediately ask the sender for instructions and safeguard the goods.
evidence: Codice civile artt. 1690 e 1686: istruzioni al mittente e custodia in caso di impedimento alla riconsegna https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ita197336.pdf

rows.text: Total loss concerns all the goods entrusted and not delivered; the cause of nondelivery is separate from the question of the carrier’s liability.
evidence: Codice civile artt. 1687 e 1693: obbligo di riconsegna e responsabilità per perdita con possibili cause di esonero https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ita197336.pdf

rows.text: Loss is partial when only part of the quantity entrusted arrives: for example, packages or part of the weight may be missing.
evidence: Convenzione CMR artt. 17 e 23: perdita parziale e peso mancante https://unece.org/DAM/trans/conventn/cmr_e.pdf

rows.text: Delivery gives effect to the transport contract: the place, deadline and manner are those agreed or, failing that, those established by custom.
evidence: Codice civile art. 1687: messa a disposizione del destinatario secondo contratto o usi https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ita197336.pdf

rows.text: Damage means deterioration of the delivered goods: the quantity may arrive, but its condition has worsened and its value fallen.
evidence: Convenzione CMR art. 25: indennizzo per avaria basato sul deprezzamento https://unece.org/DAM/trans/conventn/cmr_e.pdf

rows.text: The tachograph card identifies the driver and records activities; it does not prove employment by a particular company.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 165/2014 artt. 2 e 34: funzione della carta del conducente e registrazione delle attività https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2014/165/oj

rows.text: Overloading incurs the penalties applicable to the measured mass and excess; the stated excess does not automatically lead to licence suspension.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 167 commi 2, 3 e 10: sanzioni per eccedenza e condizioni per proseguire https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-167.php

rows.text: A suitable vehicle is not enough: for transport covered by the regulation, the applicable authorizations and training or certificates are also needed.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 1/2005 artt. 3, 6 e 17: idoneità del mezzo, autorizzazione e competenza, con limiti di applicazione https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2005/1/oj

rows.text: The goods are not automatically returned to the sender. The driver informs the company; the carrier must promptly ask the sender for instructions and safeguard the goods.
evidence: Codice civile artt. 1690 e 1686: istruzioni al mittente e custodia https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ita197336.pdf

rows.text: An absent consignee or refusal does not by itself require a police call. The driver informs the company; the carrier promptly asks the sender for instructions.
evidence: Codice civile artt. 1690 e 1686: istruzioni al mittente e custodia https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ita197336.pdf

rows.text: The quiz marks FALSO: ATP 2024 states up to 3 °C, not 1 °C, as the maximum permitted temporary rise on the surface of part of the load during certain brief operations. A 1 °C rise is nevertheless within the 3 °C limit when all conditions apply.
evidence: https://unece.org/sites/default/files/2024-04/ATP%202024_E_pdf_web_protected.pdf — ATP 2024 Annex 2 paragraph 4 p.93: brief maximum 3°C surface rise in part of load during particular operations; historical edition. A rise of 1°C lies within 3°C, subject to all conditions. Direct text access limited; indexed primary text inspected by independent adjudicator.

rows.text: Under the registration conditions applicable to category 5, packages of hazardous waste carry a black R on yellow, not red RP on white. Applicable ADR requirements must also be followed.
evidence: Albo Nazionale Gestori Ambientali, deliberazione n.3 del 7 febbraio 2022, allegato C, prescrizioni categoria 5 e categoria 1 con codici pericolosi, punto 8(b), https://www.albonazionalegestoriambientali.it/download/it/deliberecomitatonazionale/115-Del3_07.02.2022.pdf — etichetta inamovibile R nera su fondo giallo sui colli; punto 8, paragrafo finale: ADR ove applicabile. Scope registration conditions, not universal claim beyond them.

rows.text: ATP concerns perishable foodstuffs and special transport equipment. Dangerous goods are subject to the relevant ADR requirements, including those for the mode of carriage.
evidence: UNECE ATP allegati 1–3 https://unece.org/info/Transport/Perishable-Foodstuffs/pub/2657 ; ADR 2025 parti 4 e 9: imballaggi, cisterne e veicoli https://unece.org/adr-2025-files

rows.text: The quiz marks FALSO: the presence of dangerous goods alone does not specify which tyres to choose. Follow the vehicle and tyre specifications, including load and speed ratings, and the requirements applicable to the transport.
evidence: European Tyre and Rim Technical Organisation, Recommendations 2 September 2024, commercial vehicle tyres https://www.etrto.org/media/j05fjxrd/etrto-recommendations-edition-2-september-2024.pdf — tyre selection must consider dimensions, load and speed with manufacturer advice.

HSE, dangerous goods main exemptions https://www.hse.gov.uk/cdg/manual/exemptions.htm — ADR requirements vary with load and applicable exemptions; UK guidance. No asserted universal negative derived merely from absence of a clause in ADR part 9.

rows.text: ATP denotes the agreement on international carriage of perishable foodstuffs and the special equipment used, not an authorization for petroleum products.
evidence: UNECE, titolo e campo dell’accordo ATP https://unece.org/info/Transport/Perishable-Foodstuffs/pub/2657

issues.reason: Il quesito stampa VERO e attribuisce allo speditore la fornitura delle istruzioni al trasportatore; la disposizione ADR attuale assegna invece al trasportatore la fornitura all’equipaggio. Una versione precedente prevedeva la fornitura dallo speditore al conducente e informazioni al vettore. Non è chiaro quale edizione o obbligo giustifichi la formulazione stampata attuale.
checked_sources: ADR 2025 5.4.3.1–5.4.3.2, https://www.mindop.sk/fileadmin/documents/doprava/nebezpecnetovary/cesta/ADR_2025_Vol._II._EN.pdf: istruzioni in cabina fornite dal trasportatore all’equipaggio prima del viaggio.

Direttiva 94/55/CE allegato ADR, versione pubblicata 2003, 5.4.3.2, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:31994L0055(02): vecchie istruzioni fornite dallo speditore e consegnate al conducente; informazioni sul contenuto al vettore.

issues.reason: Il quesito indica FALSO per un aumento massimo di 1 °C. La tolleranza verificata consente fino a 3 °C nelle condizioni indicate; un aumento non superiore a 1 °C rientra matematicamente in tale limite. Non è chiaro se il quesito intenda chiedere il massimo normativo o asserisca che un aumento di 1 °C è consentito.
checked_sources: UNECE ATP 2016, allegato 2 appendice 1, paragrafo 4, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp11/ATP_publication/ATP-2016e_-def-web.pdf: durante determinate operazioni ammette un breve aumento superficiale non superiore a 3 °C in parte del carico.

issues.reason: The cited axle-load and load-position provisions do not establish the claimed effect of route on vehicle dimensions and maneuverability. Supply a directly supporting technical or operational source.

The sole cited EU directive supports complying with axle-load limits, not a general instruction to place any single heavy package in the central area. Supply a source for appropriate placement and scope or explain axle-load distribution without asserting an unverified general central location.

The sole source is a 1984 rule for toxic and harmful waste; its cited page returned HTTP 502 and its scope does not by itself establish a present universal marking for all hazardous-waste packages. Supply an accessible applicable authority with accurate category and scope.

ADR Part 9 as cited identifies construction requirements but the evidence does not establish the stated broad negative about reinforced tyres across every dangerous-goods transport or special condition. Cite an inspectable authoritative basis for the scoped claim, or qualify the evidentiary limit.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_vehicle_review (recovery); original author /root/terra_translation_review

issues.reason: The cited 2022 Albo Delibera 3 Annex C specifies hazardous-waste package marking in point 8(b), not 7(b); point 7 concerns incompatible waste. Applicable ADR provisions are stated at the end of point 8. Correct evidence attribution; learner copy correctly describes the category 5 registration scope and colors.

reviewer_evidence: All 25 source questions and four-language explanations reviewed. The actual Albo primary PDF https://www.albonazionalegestoriambientali.it/download/it/deliberecomitatonazionale/115-Del3_07.02.2022.pdf Annex C printed p.5 and point 8(b) explicitly require a black R on yellow package marking in category 5/covered category 1 context.

30945: UK DfT long-semitrailer guide https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/longer-semi-trailer-lst-implementation-guide-for-operators/longer-semi-trailers-full-implementation-guide-for-operators confirms route and access planning. 30949: DVSA https://www.gov.uk/guidance/securing-loads-on-hgvs-and-goods-vehicles/2-load-securing-the-basics distinguishes centre line and stability; axle load requires separate consideration. UK advice is not Italian statutory proof.

30947: personally inspected indexed 2003 ADR 5.4.3.2 https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:31994L0055(02) (consignor instructions to driver, content information to carrier) and ADR 2025 https://www.mindop.sk/fileadmin/documents/doprava/nebezpecnetovary/cesta/ADR_2025_Vol._II._EN.pdf §5.4.3.2 (carrier to crew). Text correctly marks historical wording distinction.

30965: UNECE ATP 2024 Annex 2 para4 https://unece.org/sites/default/files/2024-04/ATP%202024_E_pdf_web_protected.pdf indexed primary text: brief 3°C maximum on food surface in part of load during specified operations; 1°C remains within limit, and quiz specifies 1°C as maximum. UNECE lists 2026 edition but exact newer text not independently inspected.

30968 ETRTO https://www.etrto.org/media/j05fjxrd/etrto-recommendations-edition-2-september-2024.pdf and HSE https://www.hse.gov.uk/cdg/manual/exemptions.htm reviewed for scope: tyre suitability and ADR requirements vary; no unsupported universal prohibition on reinforced tyres.
